title: Vitess: scale-out (add a REPLICA tablet to a shard)
description: The future nexus-cli VitessAdapter `scale-out` verb (add a NODE, horizontal -- per nexus-cli verb terminology) -- provisions a new vttablet+Percona tablet, joins it to shard -80 as a REPLICA (init_tablet_type=replica -> registers in topo -> VTOrc wires replication from the PRIMARY). Demonstrates per-shard read-scaling. (Contrast `scale-up` = grow CPU/RAM on an existing tablet.)

prerequisites.notes: Requires a free tablet VM + dhcp pin + Vault sidecar provisioned (foundation + security apply for the new MAC/uid). In v1 this verb documents the topology change; the VM provisioning is the terraform path (add an enable_vitess_shard1_tablet_4 module + reservation).

observe.what: new tablet nexus-103 registered in shard -80 as REPLICA; replication from the PRIMARY catching up; shard now 1 PRIMARY + 3 REPLICA
vtctld UI shows the 4th tablet SERVING after catch-up

whatProves: A shard scales horizontally for read capacity by adding REPLICA tablets without downtime; VTOrc/Vitess wires replication automatically; vtgate begins routing reads to the new replica once SERVING.
